evidence_sentence: If the transfer initiation fails, it returns FALSE. Otherwise, it sets up various callbacks for the transfer and also associates the transfer data with the file transfer object.
rationale: The fixed implementation uniquely checks whether imcb_file_send_start returned NULL and immediately returns FALSE before dereferencing px->ft or configuring it. The vulnerable implementation has no failure check and always assigns px->ft->data and callback fields, so the stated failure branch and conditional setup describe only the fixed behavior.
rewritten_docstring: The function retrieves the transfer object and the associated connection, finds the buddy to whom the file is being sent, and starts the file transfer. It sets up various callbacks for the transfer and associates the transfer data with the file transfer object.
